NAME: Beatrice Ho SCH LEVEL / BAND: P6 DATE: 6 May 2016
EDIT AND DIAGRAM SENTENCES
Rewrite and diagram these sentences
1. John took a nap at his bed room . (where)
John took a nap at his bed room.
2. Birds can fly __________. (why)
Birds can fly because they have wings.
3. We planned to visit her __________. (when)
We planned to visit her next Monday.
4. The girl sat __________. (where)
The girl sat on the sofa.
5. Peter ran and fell on the floor (how and why)

errors.note: Incorrect preposition choice; 'in' should be used with 'bedroom'.
Compound word 'bedroom' written as two separate words.
